incident_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.

result.scene_summary: A large, dark cloud formation dominates the sky above a line of trees and some buildings, with plumes of smoke or dust visible on the right side.

observations.description: Large, dark and grey plumes of smoke or dust rising from the ground on the right side of the image.
A dense line of dark trees in the foreground, with some lighter green trees and bushes in the mid-ground to the right.
A residential house with a light-colored roof and siding is visible on the right side, partially obscured by trees and smoke.
A large, ominous cloud mass in the sky, dark grey and swirling, suggesting a storm or fire-related event.
